text:
incident-bot: ALERT: 2026-03-15 02:15 UTC – high 5xx rate from inference-serving-prod across us-west-2. Trigger: error-rate > 5% for 5m. Paging sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: Got it, investigating now. pulling logs and checking autoscaler.

alex: I'm seeing a spike in KV cache misses ~02:12–02:18, memory thrash on pod k8s/inf-srv-7d7f.

maria: Reproduced locally with a load test -- long tail tokenization step causing OOM backpressure on a small subset of models.

samir: Re-routing traffic to fallback model group to reduce latency and failures. Doing 10% -> 50% ramp.

incident-bot: ACTION: traffic_shift executed by automation. policy=fallback_variant, target=50%. Logs: /ops/traffic_shifts/1779934510.log

jules: Noted a handful of customer requests failing with 502s; CS team notified. @cust-success can you bail out affected tenants list?

cust-success: Yes, sending an email to affected customers now (IDs included). short note: "We observed degraded inference responses between 02:12–02:22 UTC; mitigation in progress, will follow up with details."

eng-lead: Thanks team. sre-oncall, can you hand off when stable? Need a post-incident follow-up and owners for remediation.

sre-oncall: current status: error-rate dropped to 0.8% after ramp. CPU mem on inf-srv-7d7f still elevated but stable. I'll hand off to alex for RCA drafting in 30m.

alex: Taking ownership of RCA draft. I'll capture timeline, contributing factors, and mitigation steps. request: any extra logs or traces point me to them.

maria: I'll add the kv-cache and tokenizer reproducer artifacts to the thread and include the load test script. snippet: ```bash
# reproducer
python tools/run_reproducer.py --model rwlm-36b --seq 1024 --rate 200
```

samir: Action item: add fallback_variant profile to model catalog so future shifts are quicker. Owner: samir, due EOD +3.

jules: Action item: update runbook to include memory OOM indicator and safe traffic-shift steps. Owner: jules, due EOD +2.

eng-lead: Schedule post-incident review (not a bloated PM call, 30m sync). Proposed: 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. Who can attend?

cust-success: I'll be there to share customer impact notes.

sre-oncall: I'll attend and present timeline + mitigation.

alex: I'll bring the first RCA draft. Would like peer review from maria and eng-lead prior to the meeting.

maria: Will review and add technical appendix about tokenizer fix.

incident-bot: NOTE: created tracker ticket INF-5123: "Investigate tokenizer memory blowup on rwlm-36b; add guardrails" assigned to alex + samir. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/INF-5123

alex: Draft plan for RCA sections: 1) Summary/Impact 2) Timeline (minute granularity) 3) Root & contributing factors 4) Mitigations & interim controls 5) Long-term actions 6) Evidence attachments.

jules: Quick customer impact summary for the RCA: ~120 tenant requests failed, 8 customers reported directly, mitigation reduced failure rate to <1% within 8 minutes.

eng-lead: Good. After the review meeting we'll finalize and route for sign-off. Peer reviewers: maria, jules, eng-lead. Legal/Compliance loop if PII risk — @cust-success to flag.

cust-success: No PII exposure based on initial checks.

alex: Pushing initial RCA draft here in 30m. Will post timeline snippets like: "02:11:43 – KV cache growth begins; 02:15:02 – autoscaler OOMs; 02:16:10 – error spike reaches threshold; 02:18:35 – traffic shift to fallback initiated"

samir: After RCA, I'll prepare a quantized-model-test to validate fallback behavior under load. assign to me and eng-sre for verification.

incident-bot: REMINDER: If you add evidence to the ticket, include short descriptions and anonymize traces.

alex: Uploaded draft: https://redwood.docs/infra/rca/1779934510-draft.md (comments open).

maria: Reviewed and left inline comments about TTL and cache sizing.

jules: Left runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/142 — pls review.

eng-lead: Next steps summary (putting here so it's not lost):
- Alex: finalize RCA draft + attach logs (due +1 business day).
- Samir: add fallback variant to model catalog + quant test (due +3).
- Jules: runbook update + add traffic-shift checklist (due +2).
- Maria: reproduce writeup + tokenizer patch PR (due +4).
- Cust-success: customer follow-up emails and template (due +1).

sre-oncall: Official handoff: stable, monitoring set to alert on mem>80% for 10m; alex is owner going forward.

alex: Acknowledged handoff. I will collate everything and ping when ready for peer sign-off. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED FOR PAGING at 2026-03-15 04:15 UTC — follow-ups will continue in RCA doc and tracker INF-5123."
}
